nodes.label: Pure Library Constraint
nodes.description: phoenix_lakehouse must be a pure library: no ETL, no APIs, no Prefect, no data processing. Only defines contracts and configuration. Consuming repos do the actual work.

nodes.label: File-Based Catalog Constraint
nodes.description: Only file-based/Hadoop-style Iceberg catalog on GCS is allowed. No BigQuery catalog. All metadata under gs://lakehouse_phoenix/iceberg/. BigQuery may be used as compute engine in consuming repos but not as catalog here.

nodes.label: Why Pure Library Design
nodes.description: phoenix_lakehouse is kept as a pure library to enforce separation of concerns: contracts/config here, ETL/processing in consuming repos. This prevents coupling between layout definitions and processing logic, allows independent versioning, and keeps the dependency tree minimal.
